notes.title: Important Update about the Remake Project
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11910321/e85e590291098a4dcb020de6f876e0978daeb777.gif

Hello folks!

It has been a year and a half since we have started the project to remake Wanda, based on the various feedback we received throughout the years. We have originally planned to release the remake as a simple free update at first. 

However, due to certain publishing problems we are facing right now, we decided to release the remake as a separate game, under a completely new title in the future.

Thank you for giving us your time. We hope you will all keep supporting us with the new title.

- 
CK
Kodots Games

notes.title: Wanda - A Beautiful Apocalypse Remake Update #3
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11910321/b6931a936d0170cdbc14b9a9feb9d308a2b1268b.png

Hello!

I recently saw a comment asking about the progress on the remake and realized it's about time we make another update. The remake progressing steadily.

Progress is slower than the original version because we are updating the entire game from scratch while also adding extra playable contents.

Remember these two robots? 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11910321/bb278b1b5bb7c8ed7eab33b0416a996b89a126b8.png

Originally, we added the story about Green bot and Yellow bot from the past as a hidden story, that a player could access from collecting images scattered in the wasteland. It was a relatively simple story.

We decided to expand that side-story in the remake. This will give a great chance to look into the past, where the world was still intact and lively. In the original game, we told the story about Green Bot and Yellow Bot with nothing but static pictures. However, in the remake, you will be able to explore, interact and experience a brand new story!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11910321/5ed9a0ce8563c7ed3f0bd5a5b727a67e11f2e16b.png

Screenshots from the new story expansion 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11910321/174cbbeb3f19fe6be62f9445bb0c663884b050e0.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11910321/0a920dee9b6a117704c035dec67cc9488c3ca229.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11910321/ed4e210b369a2cac4480eb792964475d4f94f2e1.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11910321/cc58141d1ab7e58b2d2c8c511f416a4c8d1667ab.png

We improved the game's visual quality greatly in the remake, but as a result, it took considerably longer than we expected. Nevertheless, the remake is progressing well and a demo is coming up very soon!

Thanks for giving us your time. Stay tuned for more!

Cheers,
CK

notes.title: Wanda - A Beautiful Apocalypse Remake Update #2
notes.content:
Hi folks! It's time for belated update on our Wanda - Remake.

Wanda has been generally criticized for its pacing being very slow in the early part of the game. We have worked hard to smooth the pacing and reduce the clunky experience from the original version. All the maps are reworked and they have better overall sense of immersion and directions now.

 One of the newly reworked maps!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11910321/321c4c2a1631fd62cf92f0a229529461f076f8fe.png

This is the animated gif version of the remade scene. 
 New Scene  

We have also decided to add extra contents, such as new optional areas and puzzle-stages to encourage exploration. We hope these bring more depth to the mysterious world this game presents and will be engaging for the players.

A few screenshots of new areas

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11910321/7f30248d4cf9194311dce6766a844ef5ac89ac53.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11910321/3bd97a04afb83df59c00b68edf37ac7a7b0f47ea.png

And here is the newly added puzzle stage. It is one of the early puzzles, so it will not be overly complex. The UI for the mobile version are there and looks cluttered for now, it will be fixed as we progress on.

Just a new jumping puzzle
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11910321/4149d76c34a80a688a44fb886f92458f72314cc6.png

This is the animated gif version of the new puzzle.
 Jumping Puzzle  

That's all for now! Thanks for giving us your time and we hope to see again with next update soon!

notes.title: News on Major update #1 : A complete ReMake with new Engine!
notes.content:
Hello! First and foremost, many thanks to people who bought our game and backed our crowd funding campaign. It has been almost a year since we released Wanda - A Beautiful Apocalypse on Steam. There had been a lot of responses about our game during that time and they gave us critical insights about how we can improve the game. 

Despite some lukewarm responses from some players, we felt like we failed to bring the game to its full potential. There are several flaws that we overlooked when we first released the game due to our tunnel vision. Our primal goal was to make a game with subtle narrative that tells a story without saying a single word. This obsession blinded us from seeing a greater picture and created  a jarring experience with gameplay and immersion for some. Also, the limitation we had with the game engine brought many technical issues, ruining the experience for some players. 

 Update : Roadmap  

This is where we decided to remake the entire game with a new engine. This is not going to be direct port. We are going to enhance the every aspect of the game, add extra contents, iron out the flaws to create smoother gameplay and greater immersion and over all, better experience for the players. 

The subtlety of storytelling and storyline itself and Steam achievements will be left untouched. The game will also be released for multiple major platforms; PC, Mac, Linux and Mobile. Those who already own the game on Steam will have a new enhanced version as an update with no extra cost.

 Screenshots  
A Screenshot of Old version
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11910321/da10fb75370d1a64044c4f88bc76d2e2ef1a5fff.png

ReMake Screenshot  (Mobile version)
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11910321/6e8665fe38fc5f6012048bd8114ec985eadc7fdb.png

Drawbacks 
The old saves will no longer works on new remake. 

This is all we like to share for now. Since we are small-time indie developers, it might take a while for this remake to be completed but you have our words that we will make the game worthy of your time. 

If you have any suggestions, please feel free to share them with us on  Discussion Forum  here. 

You can also follow us on  Facebook ,  Twitter  and our own  Website  for updates.

Thanks you for giving us your time. See you all in next update!
ːbigbotːːlilbotːːpetbottleː

Cheers
CK
